metaDescription: American Curl vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so American Curl boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Colostrum fade is the clock behind this American Curl table, and doses at 8, 12, 16, 16 weeks exist to immunize the kitten while exposure (parks, foster homes, boarding intros) is rising.
Boarding desks ask for finished American Curl dates, not intentions, so a American Curl with only the first FVRCP dose is still incomplete for most facilities.
Ear cartilage care (not infection by default) shows up often enough in American Curls that vaccine day is also screening day — keep both on the same visit when possible.
Store the rabies label with the American Curl profile immediately; lost paperwork is the most common reason American Curl travel and kennel check-ins stall.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone American Curl shots when the kitten seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or ear cartilage care (not infection by default) worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week American Curl make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave American Curl antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed American Curl dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this medium cat.
Reset the American Curl reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the American Curl core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my American Curl misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read American Curl health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the American Curl adult health guide for breed predispositions such as ear cartilage care (not infection by default), then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
